    • setup

      public void setup(Consumer<String> failedLayoutCallback)
      Sets up the LayoutManager by loading all layouts from the layouts/ folder.

      This method should not be called manually. AdvancedGUI makes sure that the Manager is always setup.
      Parameters:
      failedLayoutCallback - will be called with the file name of json files that could not be parsed as a layout

    • reloadSingleLayout

      public Layout reloadSingleLayout(String name) throws IOException
      Reloads a single layout from its source file on disk and replaces the loaded version with it. The layout's resources (fonts, images, gifs) are re-registered.

      Changing the layout's size (frame count) is not supported here.

      Parameters:
      name - the name of the layout to reload
      Returns:
      the freshly loaded layout
      Throws:
      IOException - to indicate malformed JSON or IO errors
      IllegalArgumentException - if the layout is not loaded, its source file cannot be located or its size changed
